research_question: Can stock-market tail and realized-volatility state improve Q25 crypto risk-adjusted returns when used to forecast future crypto downside variance rather than next-day crypto return?

carrier.name: ebenezar_20260912_sharpe7_vol2
carrier.reason: current promoted crypto carrier; no carrier parameter may change in this experiment

information_set.stock_role: gross-risk sizing only; never crypto identity selection

forecast_target.name: five_day_future_crypto_downside_rms_relative_to_current_63d_downside_rms
forecast_target.use: loss scoring only after all five future returns are revealed
forecast_target.direction: higher target means more future downside risk

dynamic_aggregation.method: causal exponential model averaging on revealed squared forecast loss

health_gate.benchmark: persistence forecast: future downside RMS equals current 63d downside RMS

modes.static_median: median of four stock experts; no dynamic weighting or health gate
modes.dynamic_ungated: dynamic expert weighting; health forced to one
modes.inverted: dynamic expert risk direction inverted with same health
modes.dynamic: candidate: dynamic expert weighting plus forecast-skill abstention

falsifiers: dynamic must beat base on selection evidence at 4% ATR cost to justify the overlay
dynamic must beat inverted to support the claimed risk direction
dynamic should beat or materially improve on dynamic_ungated for the health gate to earn complexity
if static_median matches or beats dynamic, dynamic model averaging has not earned complexity
no post-result parameter rescue or threshold grid search
novelty_axes: forecast target changes from return IC to future downside variance

inspiration.claim: methodological inspiration only; no claim that the cited literature validates this exact strategy
